motions.description: Approve all items on the consent agenda including minutes, finance committee minutes, bills and vouchers for October 2025, license applications, and various resolutions and ordinances (items a through p).
Approve a raffle application submitted by Andrew Hock/Post 52 Charitable Veterans Foundation for the 'Boccin for the Red, White and Blue' bocce tournament on November 9, 2025.

Authorize ratification of President Saviano's approval of a 'Queen of Hearts' raffle application submitted by Sheila Klich, Principal St. Celestines School, to be held weekly until a winner is drawn in 2026.
